entities.summary: Alina Alekseevna Charaeva is a Russian tennis player. She has a career-high singles ranking of world No. 171, achieved on 11 August 2025, by the WTA. 203, achieved on 28 July 2025. Charaeva has won six singles and five doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit.
